     Consolidated Contractors (PNG) Limited, a contracting company
to the PNG LNG PROJECT wishes to engage
the services of skilled and experienced non-citizens who are
required urgently in the Construction Phase of the LNG
Project. The company is engaged in the construction of Komo Airfield
in Southern Highlands and the LNG Main Plant
Buildings at the Motukea Site, Port Moresby.

     The exemptions granted in accordance to Section 51 of the
Employment of Non-Citizens Act 2007 are always in
the interest of the nation and for a good cause, in view of the
PROJECT'S contribution to the country's development
in terms of economic, human resource and infrastructure development.

        The exemptions are granted from 17th March 2012 to 17th March
2013.

        Specific conditions placed against the exemptions are:-

      (1) For the company to pay a fee of K1000.00 for each employee
to the Department of Labour & Industrial
            Relations;

      (2) For the company to register all non-citizen employees that
require registration with a professional body;
      (3) For the company to provide employment opportunities

(decent work, fair pay, promotions etc.) to citizen
            workers;
      (4) For the company to provide opportunities for human
resource development and skills training to its
            employees.
      (5) Non English speaking countries to show evidence of English
proficiency for applicants.

     March 2012.
